description.en: Among the greatest jurists of the Mālikī school in his time.

transliteration.ar-Latn-x-alalc: ʿĪsā b. Muḥammad b. Muḥammad b. Aḥmad al-Jaʿfarī, attributed to Jaʿfar b. Abī Ṭālib, al-Hāshimī al-Thaʿālibī al-Maghribī, Jār Allāh, Abū al-Mahdī

tr: İsâ b. Muhammed b. Muhammed b. Ahmed el-Caʿferî, Caʿfer b. Ebî Tâlib'e nisbeten, el-Hâşimî es-Seâlebî el-Mağribî, Câru'l-Lâh, Ebü'l-Mehdî
